notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: hybrid conv/attention text backbone: 8 of 30 layers are full_attention (indices 2,5,9,13,17,21,24,27) with 8 kv heads x head_dim 64 x 2 (K,V) x 2 bytes (bf16) = 8 x 8 x 64 x 4 = 16,384 B/token (16 KiB/token). head_dim is not in config.json and is hidden_size/num_attention_heads = 2048/32 = 64. The 22 conv layers hold a fixed conv_L_cache 3 state, not growing per-token KV, and the SigLIP2 NaFlex tower is a single forward pass. max_position_embeddings 32,768 per config.json and the card.
